about.lead: I help enterprises find and close security gaps. As a Cybersecurity Consultant at Wipro, I work across cloud security, endpoint security, identity and Microsoft 365, with a focus on "Microsoft Security and Wiz Cloud/Wiz Code."
paragraphs: I started in 2008 as a Windows and infrastructure administrator, then moved through Citrix, VMware and Active Directory into Azure security and identity, and now cloud security with Microsoft 365 Defender and Wiz Cloud/Wiz Code.
That background means I understand how infrastructure really runs, so the security I design works in production, not just on paper.
bullets: Cloud posture with Wiz Cloud/Wiz Code and Microsoft Defender for Cloud
Endpoint migrations from CrowdStrike and Trellix to Microsoft Defender
Identity with Entra ID, Conditional Access, PIM, MFA and RBAC

projects.title: Endpoint Security / Microsoft
projects.text:
Endpoint Security Migration
Supported enterprise migration from CrowdStrike and Trellix to Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, with AV and ASR policies through Intune and GPO.

projects.title: Cloud Security / Wiz
projects.text:
Cloud Security Posture with Wiz
Cloud security posture visibility, security assessment and risk management across cloud environments.

points: Manage and support Wiz CSPM for cloud security posture visibility, security assessment and risk management.
Design and implement Microsoft 365 Defender across Endpoint, Office 365, Identity, Cloud Apps and Defender for Cloud.
Deliver Defender for Endpoint onboarding, AV and ASR policies, and CrowdStrike/Trellix migration using Intune, Defender for Cloud, SCCM and GPO.
Implemented Azure Security and IAM across Entra ID, Identity Protection, Conditional Access, RBAC, PIM, MFA and enterprise applications.
Supported hybrid identity, Azure network security, Key Vault, Azure Policy, Azure Arc and secure Azure Virtual Desktop environments.
Collaborated across infrastructure, identity, network and security teams, including two onsite engagements in the Netherlands.
Managed Citrix Cloud Virtual Apps & Desktops, XenApp, XenDesktop, PVS and XenServer.
Supported App-V, AppSense, Azure Compute Services and enterprise application delivery.
Supported Citrix XenApp, XenDesktop and VMware vSphere 5.x environments.
Administered Windows Server and resolved virtualization and application delivery issues.
